scope: Two separately frozen ten-task/two-repeat 60-assignment studies; all 120 originals retained, initial strictfailures not replaced and efficacy not pooled

formal.treatment: A standard native Codex / B production compact source-only / C compact complete source plus caller-selected support

confirmation.treatment: A standard native Codex / B production compact source-only / C compact complete source plus caller-selected support

historical_preservation.scope: All pre-iteration tracked benchmarks reports/configs/evidence/archives; authorized Python helper edits excluded unless under immutable evidence

explicit_extra_artifacts.selection_scope: Engineering/validation/research-fetch receipts finalized before confirmation; initial60nativefailures preserved separately under their own sealed study
selection_notes: All original60strict failures remain failures; new explicit-contract confirmation is a separately frozen corpus, not a regrade or replacement.
Top-level logs/XML/JSON retain initial failures, intermediate revisions, interrupted validation and final passes.
The first full Python receipt has1340passes; overlapping focused-suite receipts must not be added to that count.
full-python-pre-freeze-interrupted retains90completedcases and an interrupted full invocation, not a completed full-suite pass.
Raw research source/HTML, native progress/streams/grades/state, browser/environment configuration, private SQLite and fixture repositories are excluded from whitelist preparation.
Both native study artifacts are selected only after both completion guards and all independent audits pass.

Passing confirmation-collection.log duplicates seven public synthetic credential IDs; publish its exact SHA/count/AST-match receipt, keep raw text excluded. Full final XML preserves these IDs with narrow frozen-fixture exceptions. No native or failed-run evidence is omitted.
All corpus oracle stages use exact *_grade directories and named logs; four final test-file-policy controls preserve only external oracle outputs.
Earlier publisher proof failure/no-overwrite diagnostics remain historical tooling checks, not native benchmark outcomes.

whitelist.attempt_log: Only contiguous six-digit JSON records with verified hash chain

limitations: Manifest excludes itself and post-copy publication audit to avoid circular checksums.
Both study protocols and source snapshots remain independent; all initial strict failures and spend remain visible.
Campaign cost per success includes failed prior-study attempts; it is operational accounting, not pooled causal efficacy.
Credential scanning is pattern-based and cannot prove absence of every possible secret.
Exact Git-AST-bound synthetic XML exceptions preserve original bytes and scan all other original spans.
Common prompts and delivery attestations are preserved; private stdin descriptors, native state, auth, SQLite, fixture repositories/worktrees and untracked file contents are excluded.
